messages:
Riley Gomez: heads-up — after flipping the "per-project sticky" routing flag in canary, billing flagged a bunch of requests attributed to project `-` for tenant `openwave` at ~09:03. dashboard: https://dash/issue/1221
Anika Singh: noticed it too. looks like proxy rewrites routing to a service-account pool and the quota service sees pool-id instead of original project claim.
Dmitri Volkov: minimal change in PR: proxy attaches header `x-routed-pool` and routes earlier to improve batching. seems quota lookup runs after routing now.
June: mitigation: toggled feature `routing.sticky.per_project.openwave -> off` for that tenant via console; infra-bot applied the flag.
infra-bot: feature flag applied: routing.sticky.per_project.openwave = OFF (run id: ff-2021)
Riley Gomez: quick temporary runbook: if you see project=unknown in quota logs, flip per-tenant sticky off and notify billing. low blast radius.
Anika Singh: for a reliable fix we should forward original project claim in `x-original-project` to quota service and make quota prefer that when present. lower risk than reordering auth.
Dmitri Volkov: agree. i'll prototype header passthrough in proxy and add an integration test asserting quota uses x-original-project when present.
June: also request: add a small console card under Rollouts -> Auth Routing: "route decision vs quota project" with per-tenant filter. product wants visibility during rollouts.
billing-bot: flagged 37 requests with project=unknown between 09:02-09:05 for tenant=openwave; billing alerted.
Riley Gomez: add telemetry tag `auth.routing.decision` to token-level logs so downstream services can correlate. then we can build a histogram: routed_pool vs original_project.
Anika Singh: add alert: if any tenant has >1% of requests with project=unknown for >3m after a routing change, page eng-platform.
Dmitri Volkov: plan: header + tests in staging today, console card + alert by EOD, small canary tomorrow. owners: Dmitri header/tests, Anika console/card/alert, June runbook communication.
Riley Gomez: thanks team. will draft a short note to OpenWave ops explaining temporary global routing and that we're rolling a fix.
